scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB,WORKER --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api start" "npm --prefix apps/web run preview" "npm --prefix apps/worker start"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB,WORKER --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names RENDERER,DESKTOP --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build
scripts.check: node scripts/check-project.mjs && node --check apps/api/src/server.js && node --check apps/worker/src/server.js && node --check apps/worker/src/login.js && node --check apps/worker/src/profile-login.js && node --check apps/desktop/src/main/main.cjs && node --check apps/desktop/src/main/process-manager.cjs && node --check apps/desktop/src/preload/preload.cjs
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/worker install && npm --prefix apps/desktop install
scripts.playwright:install: npm --prefix apps/worker exec playwright install chromium
scripts.services:start: docker compose -f docker-compose.n8n.yml up -d mysql n8n
scripts.n8n:start: docker compose -f docker-compose.n8n.yml up -d mysql n8n
